paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Gamda, in R. Yosi bar Chanina's time, chapter Af Al Pi; I did not find it there. He would roll in the soil of the Land of Israel: end of Ketubot. He said, “It issued from the company's mouth”: Chullin 30a; Shabbat 3a; Pesachim 64a, 73b. In R. Assi’s name,Megillah 31b. in R. Yosi bar Chanina’s name,Sotah 7b. and in R. Yosi ben Shaul’s name, citing Rabbi,Elu Megallechin, 22a; Rosh Hashanah 24a, 30a.
